header: Creating a custom endpoint for Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Creating a custom endpoint for your Amazon OpenSearch Service domain makes it easier for you
to refer to your OpenSearch and OpenSearch Dashboards URLs. You can include your company's
branding or just use a shorter, easier-to-remember endpoint than the standard one.
If you ever need to switch to a new domain, just update your DNS to point to the new URL and
continue using the same endpoint as before.
You secure custom endpoints by either generating a certiﬁcate in AWS Certiﬁcate Manager (ACM)
or importing one of your own.
